notes: The Civic Center and Market Street, 1968 sheet p03 (2.7 ft per px; the page as scanned, lettering sideways). VAN NESS AVE., POLK ST., LARKIN ST., HYDE ST. and LEAVENWORTH run across the page; FELL ST., HAYES ST., IVY ST., ELM ST., FULTON ST., McALLISTER, GOLDEN GATE, TURK and EDDY run down it; Market St runs diagonally across the lower left, with EIGHTH ST. and SEVENTH ST. south of it. Every printed block is a polygon (49); everything else in the box is street. No open polygons: inside the box no ground lies beyond the edge of the mapped ground and there is no park, water or planted strip. Box: the given box with its right side trimmed by 10 px (x 2240 to 2230) so that the next column of blocks (its line starts at x 2231) is not cut into 1-5 px slivers; the new right side runs in street paper. The left side stays at x 1300: the printed lines stop with no closing line at about x 1280-1300, so the blocks cut there (x 1300-1312 at y 3720-3925; x 1300-1335 at y 4410-4480; the blocks at x 1300 between y 4010 and 4660) end on the box edge. How the sides were placed: each block's paper was taken from the scan (ink darker than 138), its holes filled, the ink inside its convex outline and within 8 px of its paper added (lettering touching its line, a heavy border through it), then grown 4 px into ink only (the thin lines are 3-4 px; where a heavy border lies on or beside the line the growth stops at 4 px, the thin line's outer edge; elsewhere it stops at the street paper); street paper inside the outline (dead-end alleys) stays street. Outlines simplified within 1 px. Then checked block by block on 4x-14x close-ups and on the labels picture and corrected by hand: the Ivy St block's sides straightened over the heavy line's crossing at (1521-1523, 3847-3866); the triangle at (1588-1677, 4315-4458) re-typed by hand (the C-3-G letters lie across its right side and tip: its right side is the thin line x 1674-1677 under the letters, its corner at (1677, 4316), its tip where the south-west side meets the right side under the G at (1673-1677, 4456-4458)); the corner at (1976, 4474) squared under the O of LEAVENWORTH; the right side of the block at (2102-2207, 4497-4656) straightened over a 3 px dent at (2204-2207, 4588-4593). 95% of the outline px sit within 1.5 px of the street paper outside the printed line (median 1 px). Market Street: from the south-west faces of the blocks north of it (e.g. (1338, 3975)-(1433, 4105), (1466, 4150)-(1545, 4280), (1590, 4343)-(1673, 4458), (1715, 4530)-(1805, 4655)) to the north-east faces of the blocks between Eighth and Seventh ((1378, 4463)-(1541, 4346) side and (1560, 4369)-(1722, 4603)); MARKET ST. is printed in it, and a heavy zoning border (a double line about 10-12 px wide) runs inside it from (1325, 4000) to (1690, 4485); all of it is street. Heavy zoning borders also run down many other streets in the box (for example down FULTON ST at x 1703-1708, y 4300-4480, and along the street at y 4480-4489 from x 1655 to the right side); each is street, and the street keeps its whole width from block face to block face. If it is an alley, it should be cut out. 4.
